document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You prowl the town, hoping desperately to find some source or 
clue. The water rises, and soon it’s past your ankles. You splash 
through the streets, clinging to hope.

It seems your faith was not misplaced. As you move through 
the mist, a man slams into you. You recognize him to be one of 
the dark-suited gentlemen from the ferry yesterday. The man is 
wide-eyed and pale. He carries a gun in one hand and drags a 
sizable object beside him through the rising water. You glance 
down and see it is an altarpiece, with bright jewels studded 
across its surface. You also notice a sack bulging with heavy 
goods tied about his waist. The man fixes his wild eyes upon 
you. “What are you doing!? We have to run! They’re coming for us! 
For everyone! We have to go!”
The man seems ready to panic, but perhaps you can calm him.
• Make a Persuade roll: if you succeed, go to 216; if you fail, go to 241.
